From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightPath Recruiting <talent@brightpath.co>
Date: 2026-05-18T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Q3 executive headcount commitments, comp bands & offer budgets

Team —

Attached is the proposed executive headcount commit for Q3 (summary tab in the spreadsheet). High level:
- Net +4 executive hires across Product & Infra leadership (two VP-level, one Dir Eng, one Head of PM).
- Proposed offer bands pulled from the attached comp reference (PDF) and a top-of-band cap for initial offer.
- Total incremental OTE run-rate impact (fully loaded) = ~$2.1M annualized; hiring budget is covered by reforecast.

Asks:
1) Please confirm headcount commitments and final band caps by end of day 5/19 so HR can issue LOIs to the priority candidates.
2) Laura: confirm which of the two senior IC-to-manager conversions we should prioritize vs defer.
3) Finance (Markus): confirm we can keep relocation and sign-on pool as proposed (sheet: offer_budget tab).

Notes: BrightPath has two candidates in final loops for the VP Product and Head of PM roles — Anaya is on the thread and can share updated comp expectations.

Attachments: Q3_exec_hc_commitments.xlsx, exec_comp_band_reference.pdf

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
VP, Talent & People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightPath Recruiting <talent@brightpath.co>
Date: 2026-05-18T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 executive headcount commitments, comp bands & offer budgets

Jordan —

Thanks for the packet. A couple of asks from Eng:
- For the infra leadership hires, can we convert one of the proposed senior IC roles (Platform Lead) to a Staff+ IC instead of a Director? We have a strong internal candidate pipeline and that would save ~30% on OTE.
- If we keep the VP Product role external, please set the top-of-band cap no higher than 1.15x midpoint — we can escalate for rare exceptions.

If you want, I can mark the internal candidate in the sheet and remove the headcount request for the Director role; that would reduce the net add to +3.

Jordan / all —

Finance has reviewed the workbook. Two quick items:
1) We can approve the net +4 (or +3 if Laura's change goes through) with the following constraints: initial offers should not exceed 1.2x midpoint for VP roles and 1.1x for Director-level. Any above-band exceptions go to me for pre-approval.
2) Relocation & sign-on pool: we can keep the proposed $120k pool for Q3 but ask that HR track utilization by hire and produce a weekly headcount spend report during offer season.

Please update the offer_budget tab with the expected sign-on amount per candidate; we will verify before LOI issuance.

Thank you all —

I reviewed the updated workbook after Laura's note. We will proceed with a net +3 headcount (convert Platform Lead to Staff+ IC as Laura recommended), keep the comp band caps as Markus requested (VP <=1.2x midpoint for initial offers), and maintain the $120k sign-on/relocation pool. HR will:
- Finalize LOIs for the two BrightPath finalists this week (Anaya, please confirm candidate expectations so we can set the final offer).
- Produce the weekly headcount spend report to Finance starting next Monday.
- Ensure offers include the standard executive on-call clause and 90-day performance checkpoint.

This email constitutes the executive sign-off for Q3 hiring commitments. Jordan, please route final LOIs through PeopleOps and CC me on issuance.
